name: Beeri (Hittite, father of Judith, Esau's wife)
title: Hittite father of Esau's wife Judith
summary: Beeri was a Hittite who lived in the land of Canaan during the time of the patriarchs. He is known as the father of Judith, who became one of Esau's wives. The marriage between Esau and Judith caused great grief to Isaac and Rebekah, since it was with a woman from the Canaanite peoples.

keyEvents.title: Esau's marriage to Judith
keyEvents.description: Esau took Judith, daughter of the Hittite Beeri, as his wife when he was forty years old. This marriage was a significant turning point in family history.

keyEvents.title: Grief for Isaac and Rebekah
keyEvents.description: The marriage between Esau and the Hittite women, including Judith daughter of Beeri, was a source of bitter grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

keyEvents.title: Rebekah's concern over Hittite women
keyEvents.description: Rebekah expressed her frustration with the Hittite daughters-in-law and feared that Jacob would also take a wife from among the daughters of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Jacob is Sent to Paddan-aram
keyEvents.description: As a consequence of Esau's marriage with Hittite women, Isaac and Rebekah sent Jacob to Rebekah's family in Paddan-aram to find a suitable wife.
